accepted_new_questions.title: Deferred world-deck rebuild precedes later-setup bottom draws
accepted_new_questions.question: The previous game was packed without rebuilding the world deck. During later-game setup, may you seed the regional discards and deal starting advisers from that unrebuilt stack, then rebuild the deck afterward? At exactly what point must the deferred rebuild happen?
accepted_new_questions.expected_answer: No. If the world deck was not rebuilt during the last Chronicle, perform the rebuild in the Law setup box before setup step19. Reconstruct the top12 cards from ten denizens plus two random Visions, the next18 from fifteen denizens plus the other three Visions, with remaining denizens below. Only then take the three total bottom cards to seed the three discard piles in step19, followed by each player drawing three bottom cards in step20. Do not seed or deal from the unrebuilt stack and rebuild afterward.
new_material_facts: A world deck not rebuilt during the previous Chronicle must be rebuilt before later-game setup step19, hence before both discard seeding and starting adviser draws.
repeated_facts: Discard seeding and starting advisers are drawn from bottom in the documented order

rejected_candidates.reason: These are printed individual card powers rather than a newly stated general Chronicle procedure in the narrative. The sources expressly delegate card powers to their text and allow effects beyond the Law (Law7 and9.1); Q026/Q042/Q045–046/Q066 cover access, persistence, hierarchy and baseline Chronicle/edifice procedures. Treating every readable illustration card as a separate recall target would silently expand the bank into a partial card catalogue. I did not use this illustration alone to reject working saturation. This does not claim such powers have no effect: once consulted, a card-specific preservation exception must be applied as written.
